profile_scope: unchanged v8 baseline and rejected evaluation-only negated-multicore v3
expected_invariant: Keep chip count, cores per chip and the exact negated concept distinct; a target-scoped sense note cannot be admitted from one corrected sentence while related contrasts fail.

source_lines: 这里有两颗独立芯片，不是一个多核芯片。
minimal_reproducers.ai_finding: Two independent chips become a denied multi-processor chip with several cores; the exact denial of one multi-core chip is lost in all three candidate seeds.

source_lines: 两颗芯片各自都是多核，但不是多处理器系统。
minimal_reproducers.ai_finding: One candidate sample changes multi-core inside each chip to multi-processor; baseline has the correct concept under the same exact request, so the error is sampling variability rather than exposure to the new note.

source_lines: 两颗独立芯片和一颗双核芯片不是同一个概念。

source_lines: 这里有一颗芯片、四个核心，不是四颗处理器。

source_lines: 这是一颗八核芯片，没有第二颗芯片。
